artifacts.evidence: Bounds measured from the pinned public point-collection file in this workspace.
Declared aggregate mesh z band from constraint-gauge GATE0 A17/A25; per-mesh files are not present locally yet.
Deliberately wrong control: interprets 2.4um mesh indices as 9.6um annotation indices, reproducing the historical frame mistake.

limitations: This is a z-support probe, not proof that any complete E1 ray is inside the grad_mag array.
The aggregate mesh z interval is transcribed from constraint-gauge A25 and is not yet remeasured from local mesh TIFFs.
Origins are provisionally zero; an affine/registration check is required before sampling field values.
Only relative_windings.json is measured here; other point-collection families may have different support.
